text:
Operatives of the Delta State Police Command have arrested three suspects over the alleged theft of N2 million and other valuables from a woman’s residence in Okwagbe Waterside Community, Delta State.
The suspects were identified as Bruno Jonathan, Merit Solomon and Edna Iboyi. They were arrested on October 12, 2026.
The command’s spokesperson, Bright Edafe, said operatives of the Otu-Jeremi Division arrested Jonathan following credible intelligence concerning a reported case of stealing in the community.
He said the complaint involved the theft of a Point-of-Sale (POS) machine, an Infinix mobile phone and N2 million from the residence of a female victim.
According to him, a search of Jonathan’s residence led to the recovery of a locally made cut-to-size gun and a live cartridge.
Edafe said further investigations led to the arrest of Solomon and Iboyi in connection with the alleged theft.
He added that the three suspects remained in police custody as investigations continued to establish their respective roles in the incident.
They would be charged to court upon the conclusion of the investigation, he said.
